hero.title: The digital soul of your home.
hero.subtitle: A calm, intentional space to organize tasks, align finances, and preserve the memories of those who live with you. No noise, only the essential.

showcase.title: One home, a place for everything.
showcase.subtitle: Tasks, bills, and what matters — in one place, without noise.

organization.title: Shared organization
organization.body: Shopping lists, chores, and household routines that everyone can follow without extra effort.

finances.title: Transparent finances
finances.body: Track joint expenses and plan the household budget with clarity.

memories.title: Preserved memories
memories.body: A secure digital vault for important documents and family photos.

one.title: Create your Domus
one.body: Set up the space in less than a minute.

two.title: Invite who belongs
two.body: Add partners, children, or housemates with secure access.

three.title: Look after the home together
three.body: Share the daily routine for a more organized house.

privacy.title: Your home remains yours.
privacy.body: We do not sell data, we do not show ads, and we use end-to-end encryption. What happens in your Domus stays in your Domus.

one.question: Who can join our Domus?
one.answer: Only people you invite. Access belongs to the household, not to an open network.

two.question: Do you sell or advertise with our data?
two.answer: No. We do not sell data and we do not show ads.

three.question: Do we need an app?
three.answer: No. Domus works in the browser, on a computer and on a phone.

cta.title: Fewer things to remember. More room to live.

start.title: How do you want to start?
